question: If "PATNA" is written as "ANTAP", how is "RAJASTHAN" written?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/af6e2be48e5356afbd9730792b3a81cd0615caa5292f4a1845baf20d14666382.png] 

The logic followed here is : 

For, 'PATNA is written as ANTAP',

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/db1f6eec15335da4217dde72737aae6dca7b6dfc9fedd3f1501e2dcd73275690.png] 

The word is reversed: PATNA → ANTAP

Similarly, for ** 'RAJASTHAN'** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a5976d9cba5113f9028a07903f903b796a28a1be37b35171bfc197d95db21471.png] 

So, 'RAJASTHAN' will be written as 'NAHTSAJAR'.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
